author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 
GO:0006082 organic acid metabolic process
GO:0016053 organic acid biosynthetic process
GO:0016054 organic acid catabolic process
GO:0031388 organic acid phosphorylation
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31816

replaced by GO:0008152 metabolic process

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ejcT6Pnpd4AbUUW_a4C2y5qPgb9JRljuakskpHA6vMU/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
BHF-UCL	4 -done
FlyBase	1
MGI	1
UniProt	1
SGD	1

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
GO:0006082	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR004372 Acetate/propionate kinase > GO:organic acid metabolic process ; GO:0006082
GO:0031388	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR004381 Glycerate kinase > GO:organic acid phosphorylation ; GO:0031388
GO:0031388	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR018193 Glycerate kinase, flavodoxin-like fold > GO:organic acid phosphorylation ; GO:0031388
GO:0031388	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR036129 Glycerate kinase superfamily > GO:organic acid phosphorylation ; GO:0031388
GO:0031388	unirule2go	UniRule:UR000129101 > GO:organic acid phosphorylation ; GO:0031388



Thanks.

Best
Sara
